candidates.name: Mode-Exclusion Resampling (MER): negative conditioning on the pool's own modal answer
candidates.core_mechanism: Budget n=16 split 8/8, applied UNCONDITIONALLY to every item (no routing — wall #4 says tallies cannot identify which items need it, so none is attempted). Phase 1: 8 i.i.d. traces under the exact frozen baseline protocol (batch size held fixed, since measured difficulty is protocol-dependent). Extract the normalized modal answer m1 and a 1–2-line method sketch taken verbatim from one modal trace's own stated plan. Phase 2: 8 traces conditioned on a fixed adversarial preamble: 'A prior solver answered {m1} using roughly this approach: {sketch}. Treat {m1} as the product of a systematic error until independently verified. Solve from scratch by a fundamentally different method; you may report {m1} only after an explicit check step.' Every trace (both phases) ends with the standard verbalized-confidence field. Output = the union pool of all 16 traces; Phase-1 is retained, so union gold-in-pool ≥ Phase-1 gold-in-pool by construction (monotone guard). Aggregation downstream is TACT/confidence-weighted voting over the mixed pool; Phase-2 traces are non-exchangeable and may be a-priori down-weighted for accuracy, but ceiling accounting is weighting-independent.
candidates.why_it_raises_the_ceiling: The measured decisive-stratum failure is that the model re-enters the same wrong basin on nearly every draw: with intraclass correlation ρ near 1, draws 9–16 have almost zero marginal coverage value (n_eff saturates at 1/ρ — the correlation ceiling Bay & Yearick formalize). MER makes the attractor's answer token and its method sketch explicit negative context, forcing the model to renormalize over the residual solution space. If the correct basin has any nonzero conditional mass once the dominant basin is masked, the 8 conditioned draws sample from a distribution enriched for it — converting duplicate draws into coverage draws exactly on plurality-wrong items, where duplicates were most wasteful. On plurality-correct items gold is already in the retained Phase-1 pool, so the ceiling cannot drop below Phase-1's; the only cost is 8 foregone baseline draws, which on those items were duplicates with high probability. It also constructively closes the loop on our own sufficiency proof: wall #4 shows final tallies are all the label-free information there is — MER is what you do with that information at generation time instead of weighting time.
candidates.why_not_already_dead: Impossibility map: walls 1–4 govern post-hoc extraction from a fixed exchangeable pool; MER changes the generative distribution, and it respects wall #4 by applying unconditionally (no tally-based routing). Prior art deltas: ARBITER (2605.26172) is explicitly post-consensus selection 'rather than generating new samples' — powerless on the 6/10 zero-gold items; Bay & Yearick (2606.28661) formalize the correlation ceiling but propose no intervention; Mirror-Consistency (2410.10857) harvests observed inconsistency, which stable wrong majorities do not exhibit — empty signal exactly on the decisive stratum, whereas MER manufactures the challenge; RAD/Hint-Marginalization (2412.13292) and Progressive-Hint condition POSITIVELY on prior answers (increases correlation — opposite sign); Huang et al.'s 'LLMs Cannot Self-Correct' shows challenge-and-REPLACE degrades accuracy by flipping correct answers, but MER replaces nothing — flipped Phase-2 traces cannot remove gold from the union pool, and the selection burden shifts to TACT, whose within-item discrimination (D=+0.250, z=+2.54) is our measured asset; multi-agent debate shares full majority reasoning and converges to it, MER injects only its negation; premise perturbation/DivSampling/paraphrase perturb the question surface, which FIB proved frame-invariant errors survive — MER perturbs conditioning on the model's own answer statistics, which paraphrase leaves untouched.
falsifiable_claims: Coverage: on the 6 decisive-stratum items with gold-in-pool = 0 at 16 baseline draws, MER (8+8) puts gold in the pool on ≥2 of 6 items; 0/6 kills the mechanism.
Ceiling: decisive-stratum oracle ceiling rises by ≥0.2 absolute (4/10 → ≥6/10), pushing the full-set oracle ceiling above 0.933 at matched budget n=16.

Decorrelation: on decisive items the fraction of Phase-2 traces landing in the Phase-1 modal basin falls below 0.5 (baseline ≈0.9 of i.i.d. draws), i.e., cross-phase intraclass correlation measurably drops.
No-harm: on plurality-correct items, union gold-in-pool is within 2 percentage points of 16-i.i.d. gold-in-pool (bounds the budget-split cost; large drops are impossible by the monotone guard).

Composition: TACT/confidence-weighted selection over mixed pools recovers strictly more of the new ceiling than unweighted SC — Phase-2 traces that capitulated away from a correct mode verbalize lower confidence than Phase-2 traces that found an independent correct path.
candidates.cheapest_decisive_test: Frozen Haiku on the frozen 119-item MATH L5 set. Phase-1 costs nothing: subsample 8 of the existing 16 baseline traces (3 random subsamples for stability). Kill version: 10 decisive items × 8 conditioned traces = 80 new generations (~$1, one afternoon); kill criterion = coverage claim fails (0/6 zero-gold items gain gold ⇒ errors are capability-limited, not anchoring-limited). Confirm version: all 119 items × 8 = 952 new traces (~$10), checking the ceiling, decorrelation, no-harm, and composition claims under the owned decisive-stratum + oracle-ceiling accounting.

candidates.name: Trace-Grounded Method Exclusion (TGME): sequential sampling that bans the model's own observed strategies, never its answers
candidates.core_mechanism: Solver prompt requires a structured header — line 1 'METHOD: <one-sentence strategy>', then the solution, then the verbalized-confidence field — so plan extraction costs zero extra calls. Budget n=16: 4 unconditioned seed draws; maintain exclusion list L of distinct METHOD lines observed so far (dedup by normalized string or cheap embedding threshold; final answers are NEVER placed in L). Then 3 waves of 4 draws (parallel within wave, sequential across waves), each conditioned on: 'The following strategies have already been attempted: {L}. Do not use them or minor variants; commit to a structurally different strategy before solving and state it in your METHOD line.' After each wave, append new distinct METHOD lines to L. Output = union pool of all 16 traces, seeds retained; TACT aggregates. Label-free by construction: L is built solely from the model's own emitted headers. Crucially, a forced trace that re-derives the modal ANSWER via a genuinely new method is allowed and kept — reconvergence under method exclusion is evidence FOR that answer, preserved rather than suppressed. This makes TGME and MER separable hypotheses: MER bets decisive errors are answer-anchoring-driven; TGME bets they are method-availability-driven.
candidates.why_it_raises_the_ceiling: Our traces show the model takes the same wrong path nearly every draw: on decisive items, 16 i.i.d. draws yield ~1–2 distinct methods (verifiable from the frozen traces without labels). If gold is reachable by SOME method the model can execute but that method's prior availability is masked by the attractor, i.i.d. sampling never surfaces it in 16 draws — while explicit exclusion of every observed method forces probability mass onto the tail of method space each wave, so method-space coverage grows roughly linearly in waves instead of saturating at the attractor after draw 1. Gold enters the pool iff gold is method-reachable, which is exactly the hypothesis the decorrelation program needs to price: if genuinely different executed methods still land on the same wrong answer, the error is concept-level, not path-level — a cheap, decisive negative that terminates the whole corner.
candidates.why_not_already_dead: Not blocked by the impossibility map: it modifies generation, uses no labels, and routes nothing (unconditional application; wall #4 respected). Deltas from named prior art: DIV-SE/Diversity-of-Thought, StrategyLLM, and brainstorm-then-select build a-priori menus by asking the model what approaches EXIST — TGME's exclusion list is what the model actually DID, i.e., its empirical attractor; menu execution routinely collapses back to that attractor, and the June-2026 measurement paper (2606.29985) documents precisely this gap (nominal diversity is phrasing-level while approach-level diversity stays flat) — TGME's compliance claim is designed against that failure mode, and none of those works evaluate gold-in-pool on the plurality-wrong stratum at matched budget (they report end-task accuracy, confounding generation with aggregation). ToT/GoT branch mid-solution from shared prefixes under a value function — branches inherit the attractor's framing and need an evaluator; TGME forks at the strategy-commitment point before the first step, evaluator-free. Diverse beam/min-p/typical/temperature are token-level and cannot move distribution-level path correlation (the ρ in the correlation-ceiling formula). FIB (ours) showed input-side perturbation fails; TGME moves the perturbation to the solution process, which paraphrase-invariance says is where the correlation lives. Sequential-revision work (e.g., iterative deepening, revision models) conditions on prior ATTEMPTS to improve them — positive conditioning toward the attractor — not on excluding prior strategies to escape it.
falsifiable_claims: Forcing works: forced waves produce ≥4 distinct METHOD lines per decisive item where the 16 frozen baseline draws contain ≤2 (measurable with no labels).

Compliance is structural, not nominal: embedding distance on solution bodies (not headers) or an independent judge confirms ≥60% of forced traces differ structurally from the attractor solution — guarding against relabeling the same computation (the 2606.29985 failure mode).

Coverage: on the 6 zero-gold decisive items, TGME yields gold-in-pool > 0 on ≥2; 0/6 WITH confirmed compliance ⇒ decisive errors are concept-level — a publishable negative that closes the decorrelation corner.
No-harm: plurality-correct strata retain gold-in-pool within 2 points of baseline (4 retained seeds + answer-reconvergence-allowed design).

Mechanism separation: the decisive items rescued by TGME and by MER overlap only partially; identical rescue sets would collapse both to a generic 'try again differently' effect and void the two causal stories.
candidates.cheapest_decisive_test: 10 decisive items, seeds subsampled free from the frozen 16-trace baseline, 12 forced traces per item = 120 new Haiku generations (~$1.50, one afternoon) plus one cheap compliance pass (embedding distances on solution bodies). Kill criterion: compliance confirmed ≥60% AND gold-in-pool stays 0 on all 6 zero-gold items. Confirm criterion: distinct-method count ≥4 per item and gold enters the pool on ≥2 of 6, raising the decisive-stratum oracle ceiling at matched budget.

candidates.name: Fork-and-Firewall (FAF): commitment-point branching with an answer-tight context barrier
candidates.core_mechanism:
Budget: 16 solution generations/item, matched to SC-16.

STAGE 0 (4 calls, seeds). Draw 4 vanilla samples at production temperature. Keep traces + answers + verbalized confidence (same elicitation as our TACT runs).

STAGE 1 (1 short call, fork extraction). Truncate each seed trace to its SETUP PREFIX: cut at the first token position introducing a numeral not present in the problem statement (i.e. the first derived quantity), or at 25% of tokens, whichever is earlier. This truncation is what mechanically removes the answer. Prompt, given the 4 prefixes: "These prefixes commit to particular readings of the problem. List the COMMITMENT POINTS -- places where a careful, competent solver could legitimately have read or set up the problem differently. For each give 2-3 mutually exclusive alternative readings, each a single imperative sentence about how to read or set up the problem. Do not solve. Do not state any answer or any quantity not in the problem statement." Target ~12 directives after dedup.

STAGE 2 (deterministic firewall filter, no model call). Admit directive f only if: (i) every numeral in f occurs in the problem statement; (ii) f contains no answer-shaped assertion (no 'the answer'/'equals'/'therefore' + numeral); (iii) f is not near-duplicate of the seeds' own default reading (n-gram/embedding dedup vs the prefix set). Log rejection rate as a reported diagnostic.

STAGE 3 (12 calls, blind branch solving). For each admitted f_j, a FRESH context containing ONLY: original problem + "Read the problem as follows: <f_j>. Solve it completely." No seed trace, no seed answer, no sibling forks, no hint that this is a retry. Invariant: zero answer tokens and zero seed-reasoning tokens ever enter a Stage-3 context.

STAGE 4 (aggregation, pre-registered, no new information). Pool = 4 seeds + 12 branch answers. Arm (a) flat SC-16; arm (b) TACT confidence-weighted (branch samples emit confidence identically to seeds, so the D=+0.250 / z=+2.54 channel transfers unchanged). Report gold-in-pool (oracle ceiling), SC, TACT.

Budget honesty: 17 total calls, but only 16 are solution-length; extraction output is ~150 tokens and is mostly prefill. Report a strict token-matched variant with 11 branches (total output tokens <= baseline) alongside the 12-branch call-matched variant.
candidates.why_it_raises_the_ceiling:
Our measured decisive-stratum failure is a shared SETUP, not a shared slip: the model takes the same wrong path nearly every time and gold was never sampled in 16 tries on 6/10 items. Temperature sampling perturbs tokens downstream of that commitment, where entropy lives (phrasing, arithmetic), and essentially never re-opens the setup, whose tokens are low-entropy precisely because the model is confidently wrong. FAF moves the perturbation upstream of the attractor -- it is the only lever that touches the site where the correlation is generated.

The load-bearing bet is a capability asymmetry: ENUMERATING plausible readings of a problem is a generation/recall task the model is far better at than CHOOSING correctly among them. Two-world unidentifiability forbids the choosing; it says nothing about the enumerating. If the gold setup is one of the 2-3 alternatives the model can name at a commitment point, one blind branch solve puts gold in the pool, and SC/TACT then get an item they previously could not win at any weighting.

SCoP's own result -- surface-form perturbation helps disproportionately on 'initially unsolvable' problems -- is independent evidence that upstream perturbation moves items downstream sampling cannot. FAF aims the same lever using the model's own committed prefix instead of firing blind, so the perturbation lands on the actual attractor rather than on a random paraphrase axis.
candidates.why_not_already_dead:
IMPOSSIBILITY MAP. (1) Error-rate bound 1-(pooled mode share) is a bound GIVEN a pool; FAF changes the pool, so the bound moves with it -- no bound is contradicted. (2) Two-world unidentifiability governs which candidate is right; we never label, never score, never select -- selection stays plain SC/TACT. (3) Verifier anchoring (delta +0.115/-0.067, dead): nothing in FAF is ever asked 'is this right' -- there is no verification step to inherit that death. (4) Label-free routing (tallies are sufficient statistics; stable wrong majorities invisible): the main claim requires NO per-item trigger -- FAF is applied uniformly to every item. Triggered/adaptive variants are a secondary efficiency question and are not load-bearing.

ISC ECHO CONTAMINATION. ISC's verifiers failed because a candidate answer sat in the context and the model rationalized it; answer-cue-masking studies report consistency collapsing ~26.9 points when cues are removed, i.e. anchoring was doing the work. FAF's Stage-3 contexts are answer-free BY CONSTRUCTION via two independent mechanisms: prefix truncation before the first derived numeral, plus a mechanical numeral-containment filter on every admitted directive. The audit is exact and reportable (claim 2), not a hope.

PRIOR ART DELTAS. DiVeRSe (Li 2022): diverse prompts + a trained verifier; we drop the verifier (it is measured dead here) and keep only the diversity, aimed rather than assorted. Diversity-of-Thought (Naik 2023) and Self-Contrast (Zhang, ACL 2024): both branch over a menu of solution METHODS/perspectives fixed independently of what the model actually committed to, and Self-Contrast feeds discrepancies back for revision -- contamination by design. FAF branches on PROBLEM-READING commitments harvested from the model's own truncated setup, and forbids all feedback. SCoP (2404.11500): paraphrases the statement blind, never conditions on the model's own solution, never reports coverage. ToT/GoT/MCTS/entropy branching: branch at uncertainty and prune with a value model; FAF branches at a site the samples AGREE on and prunes nothing (pruning would be verification).

AIMO-3 (2603.27844), the sharpest threat: Diverse Prompt Mixer lost to baseline on every arm -- but on gpt-oss-120b with measured pairwise error correlation ALREADY at rho-hat = -0.122. With nothing to decorrelate, method-swaps only paid the per-sample accuracy tax. That null is conditioned on a decorrelated regime; ours is the degenerate one. They explicitly tested no intervention conditioned on prior samples or extracted assumptions. The delta is a stated moderation hypothesis, falsifiable in claim 5, and informative in either direction.
falsifiable_claims: Gold-in-pool on the pre-registered decisive stratum rises from baseline 0.40 to >= 0.60 at matched generation budget. Pre-registered on an EXPANDED stratum of n >= 50 decisive items -- our n=10 has no power and the primary endpoint must not be run on it.
Zero answer leakage: 0 of the admitted fork directives contain the seed's final answer or any numeral absent from the problem statement, on a 100% mechanical audit of all directives.
Branches are genuinely new, not re-derivations: >= 35% of Stage-3 answers differ from every seed answer, and the distinct-answer count per item rises by >= 1.5 on the decisive stratum.
No dilution catastrophe: on the non-decisive stratum (baseline SC already correct), SC-16 accuracy falls by <= 1.5 points absolute; TACT-weighted accuracy falls by <= 1.0.

Moderation vs AIMO-3: the gold-in-pool gain is monotone increasing in baseline pool degeneracy (top-1 share) and is <= 0 for items with top-1 share < 0.4. If the gain is flat in degeneracy, the reconciliation story with AIMO-3's null is false.

Targeting is load-bearing: FAF beats a control with the SAME branch count whose forks are generated WITHOUT seeing any seed prefix (blind, SCoP-adjacent). If this ablation is not beaten, the 'use the model against itself' thesis is dead even if end accuracy improves -- report it as a kill.
candidates.cheapest_decisive_test:
PHASE 0 -- fork-reachability probe. 6 API calls, under $1, no pipeline, one afternoon. Take the 6 decisive items where gold was never sampled in 16 tries. Run Stage-1 fork extraction on each (seeds already exist in the frozen Haiku traces). Then check BY HAND against the gold solution whether any admitted directive corresponds to the setup that yields gold. Labels are used offline for scoring only; they never enter the method. Decision rule: gold's setup enumerated on <= 1 of 6 -> the enumeration-beats-selection bet is false, FAF cannot work for the reason it claims, STOP. >= 3 of 6 -> proceed. This isolates the single load-bearing assumption for six calls, before any code exists.

PHASE 1 -- matched-budget run. 300 MATH-L5/AIME-style items. SC-16 baseline first to define the decisive stratum (expect n = 50-70), then FAF-16 on the same items. Primary endpoint: gold-in-pool on the decisive stratum, McNemar on discordant items (need ~12 discordant pairs for 80% power at the claimed 0.40 -> 0.60 shift, which n=50-70 supplies). Secondary: SC and TACT accuracy on all 300 to block cherry-picking, plus the blind-fork ablation arm (claim 6) and the degeneracy-moderation regression (claim 5). ~10-14k generations, well under $100 on Haiku.

candidates.name: Consensus-Cut Resampling (CCR): branch where the samples agree, not where they disagree
candidates.core_mechanism:
Budget: 16 calls/item, matched to SC-16.

STAGE 0 (4 calls, seeds). Each seed emits its solution plus a structured <facts> block: one line per derived quantity, 'name = value :: <self-contained question whose answer is that value>'. The question must reference only the original problem, never later steps.

STAGE 1 (deterministic, no call: the consensus cut). Align facts across the 4 seeds by question text (embedding match). Find the EARLIEST fact on which >= 3 of 4 seeds agree on the value and which is not a restatement of a problem given. That is the cut point c with sub-question q_c. Contrarian principle: cut at maximal AGREEMENT. Uncertainty-guided branching (ToT, MCTS, entropy branching) is structurally unable to help here because our decisive errors are stable and confident -- there is no uncertainty at the error site to guide on. CCR is the constructive dual of our own finding 4.

STAGE 2 (4 short calls, blind sub-derivation). FRESH context containing ONLY the original problem + "Answer only this: <q_c>" -- no value, no seed reasoning, no downstream framing. Sample 4x. Collect distinct values V = {v_1..v_r}, typically 1-3. Firewall check on q_c: reject any q_c containing a numeral absent from the statement, or containing its own answer.

STAGE 3 (8 calls, downstream re-solve). For each distinct v in V -- INCLUDING the consensus value, so the default is never handicapped -- fresh context: problem + "It is given that <q_c> has answer v. Complete the solution." Allocate the 8 calls across V proportional to Stage-2 vote share, minimum 2 each.

STAGE 4. Pool = 4 seeds + 8 downstream answers; SC and TACT arms as in FAF. Report gold-in-pool, SC, TACT. Stage-2 calls are short; report a strict token-matched variant.
candidates.why_it_raises_the_ceiling:
For gold to be unreachable on a decisive item, TWO things must both hold: the model cannot get the pivotal sub-quantity right even when asked in isolation, AND it cannot finish correctly even when handed the right sub-quantity. CCR attacks both, and both are frequently false. (i) The isolated sub-question is a strictly easier task than the full item, so its marginal accuracy is higher -- and stripping the downstream framing removes the very context that makes the full-solve attractor fire, so the isolated draw is not merely a re-roll of the same distribution. (ii) The downstream, given a correct pivot, is largely mechanical. CCR converts one hard joint problem into two easier conditionals and unions the results into the pool.

This is a CAPABILITY argument, not a diversity argument, which is exactly why it can survive AIMO-3's demonstration that pure diversity injection buys nothing: CCR does not re-roll the same task with different flavoring, it changes what the model is asked to do. On the decisive stratum -- where 6/10 items never saw gold in 16 iid draws -- re-rolling the same task is provably the losing move, and CCR is the only proposal here that stops re-rolling it.
candidates.why_not_already_dead:
IMPOSSIBILITY MAP. No candidate is ever scored or selected (verifier anchoring, finding 3, untouched). No correctness claim is made from agreement -- agreement is used only to LOCATE a cut, never to predict which value is right, so finding 4's death of label-free routing does not bite. Two-world is respected: SC/TACT still choose. The 1-(mode share) bound is a bound given a pool, and the pool is what changes.

CONTAMINATION. The only text crossing the Stage-2 firewall is q_c, mechanically constrained to the problem's own vocabulary with no derived numerals and no self-answer. Stage 3 does inject a value v, which IS an anchoring surface -- the honest weak point -- but it is framed as a GIVEN, not as a candidate answer to endorse, and critically V always includes the consensus value, so anchoring pressure is symmetric across branches and cannot systematically privilege the seed answer. Claim 5 tests whether the anchoring is nonetheless doing the work.

PRIOR ART DELTAS. Least-to-Most / decomposition prompting: decompose BEFORE solving, from the statement, and use the decomposition as the single path; CCR decomposes AFTER, at an empirically located consensus point, uses it to WIDEN the pool, and keeps the original path in the pool. ToT / GoT / MCTS / adaptive-branching / entropy-guided branching: all branch at uncertainty and prune with a value model or verifier; CCR branches at maximal certainty and prunes nothing. The branch-site rule is the literature's inverse, and it is forced by our measured fact that wrong majorities are stable. Self-refine / debate / Self-Contrast: all place a candidate answer or critique in context; CCR never does. SCoP: perturbs the statement surface; CCR perturbs an internal commitment. AIMO-3's Diverse Prompt Mixer swapped METHODS on the same task; CCR changes the task's granularity, and their null (rho-hat = -0.122, already decorrelated) does not cover it.
falsifiable_claims: Decomposition gain exists: on the decisive stratum, the isolated sub-question at the cut is answered correctly by at least one of 4 samples at a rate >= 20 points above the rate at which the seeds got that same quantity right in-context. If isolation does not help, the whole mechanism is vacuous.
Downstream is mechanical: given the gold value at the cut, downstream re-solve reaches gold on >= 60% of decisive items.
Gold-in-pool on the decisive stratum >= 0.60 at matched 16-call budget (baseline 0.40), pre-registered on n >= 50 decisive items.

Extraction is faithful: the <facts> block matches quantities actually used in the trace on >= 90% of a hand-audited sample of 40 traces. This is the pipeline's weakest link -- if parsing is unfaithful everything downstream is noise, so it is audited before any accuracy number is computed.

Cutting at agreement beats cutting at disagreement: a control cutting at the earliest maximally-DISAGREED fact yields strictly lower gold-in-pool gain. If the control wins, the contrarian principle is wrong even if the headline numbers look good -- report it as a kill.

Anchoring is not carrying the result: a control in which Stage 3 is given a deliberately wrong (randomly perturbed) pivot value must NOT reach gold at more than chance; if it does, Stage 3 is ignoring the injected given and the branch structure is decorative.
candidates.cheapest_decisive_test:
THE ORACLE-REPAIR PROBE -- ~400 calls, about $5, no pipeline built, decides CCR and also arbitrates between the two candidates.

On the 10 decisive items plus ~40 more harvested at the same difficulty, take one seed trace each and hand-identify, using the gold solution offline (labels never touch the method), the EARLIEST intermediate quantity the trace got wrong. Then run exactly two prompts per item, 4 samples each:
  (a) the isolated sub-question for that quantity -- does the model get it right when asked alone, with the downstream framing stripped?
  (b) the original problem plus the gold value for that quantity as a stated given -- does it then finish correctly?

The joint rate (a)x(b) is a hard UPPER BOUND on CCR's per-item yield, obtained before writing a line of the pipeline. Decision rule: both must clear ~0.5 for CCR to be worth building. If (a) ~ 0, the error is not a locally repairable commitment -- CCR is dead. If (b) ~ 0, the error is diffuse rather than pivotal -- CCR is dead, and so is any single-cut repair story.

Free by-product: this probe arbitrates the portfolio. (a) low but FAF's Phase-0 fork-reachability high -> the failure lives in the SETUP, fund Fork-and-Firewall. (a) and (b) both high -> the failure lives at a PIVOT, fund CCR. Both low on the same items -> the decisive stratum is capability-bound rather than diversity-bound for Haiku at MATH-L5, the open corner is empty at this model scale, and the correct move is to report that negative result and re-run the probe one model tier up before spending anything further.

candidates.name: SPAR — Saturation-Probed Allocation with Repulsion (sequential redirect, not stop)
candidates.core_mechanism:
Fixed budget B=16 calls/item on a frozen model. Two label-free quantities drive allocation.

STEP 1 (pilot). Draw n0=6 iid from the base policy pi0 (base CoT prompt, T*). Extract canonical answers; keep the running tally.

STEP 2 (saturation trigger). After each draw t>=6 compute the Good–Turing missing-mass estimate u_t = n1(t)/t, where n1(t) = number of DISTINCT answers seen exactly once. u_t estimates P(next iid draw yields an answer not already in the pool) — i.e. the marginal COVERAGE value of one more pi0 sample. Escalate the moment u_t < eps (default eps=0.10). Note what the trigger does and does not claim: it makes no correctness claim about the plurality (Result 4 forbids that). It says pi0 has stopped producing new support. Crucially u_t is NOT margin/entropy re-labelled: margin is a function of the top-2 counts, u_t of the singleton count, and they dissociate — tally (14,1,1) has large margin AND large missing mass; tally (8,8) has zero margin AND zero missing mass. Adaptive-Consistency/ESC/DynScaling read this saturation and STOP. SPAR reads it and SWITCHES POLICY, at equal total budget.

STEP 3 (escalation ladder, spend B_rem). Let A = distinct answers seen so far.
  L3 (1 call, only if B_rem>=4) — candidate enumeration: "List K=5 distinct final answers a careful solver might reach here, each with a one-line reason, ordered by plausibility." One call, up to 5 new candidates: the cheapest possible coverage purchase.
  L1 (alternating) — strategy-forced: one directive drawn without replacement from a bank of 4 (small-case enumeration / symbolic equation setup / casework on the binding constraint / explicit arithmetic program trace).
  L2 (alternating) — METHOD-repulsion, verbatim: "Previous attempts at this problem used one particular approach and produced these values: {A}. Solve it again from scratch using a genuinely different method. Report whatever answer your method yields, EVEN IF it matches one already listed — do not avoid an answer merely because it appears above." The repulsion targets the derivation path, not the answer token. We never ask the model to judge A.

STEP 4 (selection — the same calls, used twice). From the L2 calls compute the RETURN RATE UNDER REPULSION R(a1) = fraction of L2 calls that land back on the pi0 plurality a1 despite being pushed off its method. Let b = most frequent non-a1 answer across all escalated calls. Conservative override: answer b iff R(a1) <= 0.25 AND b was independently produced by >=2 escalated calls; otherwise answer a1. (Composable with TACT as the tiebreak among escalated nominees.)

The mechanism claim behind R: mathematics forces a correct a1 to be re-derived by a different route; a wrong attractor born of one shared flawed path is not re-reachable once that path is blocked. R is therefore a fixed-point-under-perturbation measurement, not a verification judgement.
candidates.why_it_raises_the_ceiling: Our decisive-stratum measurement says the binding failure is that gold was NEVER SAMPLED — 6 of 10 plurality-wrong items had zero gold in 16 draws, so 96 iid draws bought 0 coverage on them. Any post-hoc method fights over the remaining 4 items (oracle 0.933 vs SC 0.888). u_t is precisely the statistic that detects 'more iid draws buy nothing': on those items the pool has collapsed to 1-3 recurring answers and n1/t is near 0 by draw 8. SPAR converts the provably-worthless draws 9-16 into draws from policies with DIFFERENT SUPPORT. L3 buys support directly (one call, up to 5 candidates, no reasoning-path bottleneck at all). L2 removes the shared wrong path — the exact object our correlated-error finding identifies — from the conditioning, which is the only intervention that can move mass onto a branch pi0's attractor never enters. Arithmetic of the payoff: each of the 6 gold-absent items converted is worth +0.84 pts of oracle ceiling on our 119-item set; converting 4 of 6 moves the ceiling 0.933 -> 0.967. And because the escalated calls double as the R measurement, the coverage gain is cashable rather than stranded behind the selection wall.
candidates.why_not_already_dead:
Against the impossibility map: (1) the sharp label-free error bound governs a FIXED pool — SPAR changes the pool, so the bound's argument does not apply; we do not claim a new bound. (2) Two-world unidentifiability is about deciding correctness from a fixed sample set; R(a1) is generated by a NEW policy, so the two worlds are no longer observationally identical by construction — they differ exactly if claim 3 holds, which is why claim 3 is the kill switch. (3) Verifier anchoring died (+0.115/-0.067) because it asks a model to JUDGE a candidate. R never elicits a judgement — it counts independent re-derivations under a method block. These are different channels and the negative result on one does not transfer; if it did, self-consistency itself would be dead. (4) Tallies-are-sufficient holds for a fixed generation policy; the research context explicitly flags policy change as new information, and u_t is used only to decide the change. (5) Instability signals are blind to stable wrong majorities — agreed, which is why the trigger deliberately does NOT try to detect wrongness; it detects redundancy of pi0, a property that holds on stable-correct and stable-wrong items alike, and the cost of escalating on stable-correct items is bounded by the conservative override.
Against named prior art: OSCA (2410.22480) allocates across configs but the mixture is learned OFFLINE on a training set and is task-level — the paper states problem-specific configs are not straightforward; SPAR is per-item, training-free, triggered by a statistic from the item's own draws. Adaptive-Consistency, ESC and DynScaling (2506.16043) all answer WHEN to stop; SPAR answers WHAT to sample next at matched budget — it never returns budget. ModC (2512.01127) is chiefly a TRAINING method (fine-tuning/RL, specialist models, gradient clustering), splits compute across modes uniformly, and reports Pass@k; SPAR is inference-only on a frozen API model, splits adaptively, and reports majority-vote accuracy with gold-in-pool accounting. DivSampling (2502.11027) and DiVeRSe apply diversity UNIFORMLY and pool the diverse samples into the vote; the AIMO3 report (2603.27844) measured that exact uniform design LOSING (38 vs 39.3, all strategies below baseline) because T=1.0 already decorrelates in the POOLED average (mean rho=-0.122). That pooled average is the wrong conditional: our decisive-stratum data shows errors are correlated precisely where it matters. SPAR's delta from every one of these is that diversity is paid for only on saturated items and enters as NOMINATION plus an R measurement, never as raw votes. Per-item adaptive temperature (2510.02611) is the sharpest competitor but temperature is a scalar sharpness knob on the same conditional; claim 5 makes it an explicit control. Bay & Yearick (2606.28661) diagnose the modal ceiling and conclude 'the bottleneck is recognizing a right answer, not generating one' — our stratum-conditioned measurement says the opposite for a small model on hard math, and SPAR is the intervention that follows from our reading.
falsifiable_claims: SATURATION IS REAL: u_t = n1(t)/t drops below 0.10 by t=8 on >=60% of MATH-L5 items, and the empirically observed new-answer rate in draws 9-16 under pi0 is <= u_8 (calibration check). Falsified if new distinct answers keep arriving at a roughly constant rate — then there is nothing redundant to redirect.

REDIRECTION BUYS COVERAGE: on decisive-stratum items where gold was absent from 16 iid draws, 4 escalated calls (1x L3 + 2x L2 + 1x L1) surface gold on >=25% of items, versus <=5% for 4 additional matched iid pi0 calls. Falsified if the escalated rate is within 2x of iid.

REPULSION RETURN-RATE DISCRIMINATES (the kill switch): R(a1 | a1 correct) - R(a1 | a1 wrong) >= 0.30 with R(a1|correct) >= 0.50. Two named ways this dies: the model obeys the 'different method' pull as an answer prohibition and both R collapse near 0; or it ignores the block and both R sit near 1.
MATCHED-BUDGET WIN: SPAR at B=16 beats SC at B=16 by >=1.5 pts on the full MATH-L5 set while flipping <=1 previously-correct item to wrong (the conservative override's bounded downside).

NOT TEMPERATURE: pi0 at T=1.3 (and at the per-item optimum of arXiv 2510.02611) at matched B does not reach claim 2's coverage rate on gold-absent items. Falsified if a temperature knob alone recovers the coverage — then the contribution collapses to known work.

ADAPTIVITY IS NECESSARY: the always-escalate ablation (no u_t trigger, uniform diversity, i.e. the DivSampling/AIMO3 design) underperforms SPAR by >=1 pt on the NON-decisive stratum. We want this to be true — it is the AIMO3 tax, and it is the whole reason the trigger exists. Falsified if uniform escalation is free, in which case SPAR is unnecessary machinery over DivSampling.
candidates.cheapest_decisive_test:
Two-arm mechanism screen on the EXISTING frozen 119-item x 16-trace Haiku MATH-L5 corpus, ~400 new calls, no new pilot corpus needed.
Arm A (R-discrimination, 200 calls): take all 10 known plurality-wrong items and a random 40 of the ~109 plurality-correct items; run 4 L2 method-repulsion calls each. Compute R(a1) per item and compare group means. Pre-registered kill threshold: gap < 0.20 or R(a1|correct) < 0.40 => candidate is dead, report and stop.
Arm B (coverage, 200 calls): on the same 50 items run 4 escalated calls (1x L3 enumeration + 2x L2 + 1x L1) and, as the matched-budget control, 4 fresh iid pi0 calls. Primary endpoint is the 6 gold-absent items: control has 0 hits in 96 historical draws, so 3/6 hits from 24 escalated draws is p<0.001 by Fisher's exact against 0/96 — a decisive result from 24 draws. Secondary endpoint on the 40 easy items: measure the escalation tax (how often escalated calls introduce a plausible wrong answer that a naive pooled vote would have counted), which sizes the AIMO3 risk directly.
Cost: ~400 calls, one afternoon. Claim 1 needs zero new calls — it is computable from the frozen traces today, so run it first as a free gate before spending anything. Only if all three gates pass does the full study (which needs ~800-950 MATH-L5 items to build a 60-80 item decisive stratum at the observed 8.4% base rate) become worth funding.

candidates.name: FORK — Framing-Stratified Allocation by a Novelty Bandit
candidates.core_mechanism:
Fixed budget B=16. Replace 'one policy, B draws' with 'D policies, adaptively split, policy labels retained through to selection'.

POLICY LADDER (D=4, pre-registered, differing in problem FRAMING rather than strategy verbiage — framings target distinct root causes of a shared wrong path):
  pi_A base direct CoT (the SC policy).
  pi_B re-parse-then-solve: restate every given and every quantity asked for in your own words, flag any ambiguity, then solve. Targets shared MISREADING, a dominant L5 failure and one that is invisible to temperature because the misparse is committed in the first tokens.
  pi_C instantiate-then-generalize: compute the smallest nontrivial concrete instance, sanity-check it, then generalize. Targets shared over-abstraction.
  pi_D explicit arithmetic program trace (PAL-like but text-only, no execution). Targets shared arithmetic slips.

ALLOCATION (the novel part). Round 1: one draw per policy (4 calls). Then for each remaining call, pick the policy by Thompson sampling on a NOVELTY reward that is observable with zero labels and zero judge: r=1 if this call produced an answer not yet in the union pool, else r=0. Maintain Beta(alpha_d, beta_d) per policy with a weakly-informative prior pooled across policies (counts are tiny: shrink toward the ladder mean with a Beta(1,3) prior). Add a forced-exploration floor of 2 draws per policy so no framing is starved. The bandit therefore chases COVERAGE, not quality — there is no reward model anywhere in the loop, which is what makes it label-free.

SELECTION. Keep the policy label on every sample (the pooled tally throws it away — that discard is exactly what makes tallies 'sufficient'). Define POLICY BREADTH br(x) = number of distinct framings that produced answer x. Final answer = argmax by (br(x), then total count, then mean TACT confidence). Rationale: a wrong attractor is a property of one framing's derivation path; a correct answer is framing-invariant.

GUARDRAIL. If all four framings agree after round 1, the item is settled — spend the remaining 12 calls entirely on the two framings with the highest novelty posterior, purely as an attempt to BREAK the agreement. An answer that survives 12 adversarial attempts across framings is the strongest label-free evidence obtainable; an answer that does not survive was going to be a stable wrong majority.
candidates.why_it_raises_the_ceiling: SC's iid draws are all from one conditional, so the reachable answer set is one policy's support — that is mechanically why 96 draws produced zero gold on 6 items. FORK's pool is the UNION of four supports, and the union is strictly larger exactly when the framings differ in their first-token commitments (claim 1). The bandit then spends the budget where the union is still growing rather than splitting it uniformly, which is what makes it survive the AIMO3 tax: a framing that is merely worse and not different gets no novelty reward and is starved down to its exploration floor within a few draws, automatically and per-item. Uniform mixing (DivSampling, AIMO3's Diverse Prompt Mixer) cannot do this — it pays full price for dud framings on every item. On the selection side, breadth cashes coverage differently from SPAR: it needs no override rule and no extra call, because the discriminating statistic is a free by-product of having labelled the samples.
candidates.why_not_already_dead:
Against the impossibility map: the tallies-are-sufficient result is about the UNLABELLED tally under a fixed policy. br(x) is not computable from the unlabelled tally — (8,8) split as 4+4 across two framings versus 8-from-one-framing are the same tally and different breadth. Two-world unidentifiability likewise applies to a fixed generation distribution; FORK's decision statistic is a functional of four distributions, so the construction does not transfer. This is not a claimed new bound and not a verifier — no model is ever asked to judge anything.
Against prior art: OSCA (2410.22480) is the nearest allocation relative but its mixture is fitted offline and applied task-level; FORK's split is decided per item from that item's own novelty history. MetaScale (2503.13447) is the nearest bandit relative and is the strongest threat — but its arms are meta-thoughts scored by a REWARD MODEL for response quality on open-ended tasks; FORK's reward is a free, objective indicator (did this call add a new answer) requiring no judge, and its objective is pool coverage rather than response quality. Paraphrase-and-Solve (2404.11500) and prompt-agreement confidence work do use multiple framings, but allocate UNIFORMLY and then POOL into an unlabelled majority vote — they throw away the very label FORK's selector needs, and they do not treat allocation as a decision. ModC (2512.01127) allocates across modes but is training-centred (fine-tuning, RL, gradient clustering) with a fixed split and Pass@k reporting. Adaptive-Consistency/ESC/DynScaling decide when to stop, not which policy to draw from. The honest residual risk, stated plainly: prompt-agreement as a CONFIDENCE signal is well-trodden, so FORK's selector is the less novel half — its defensible novelty is the novelty-reward bandit allocation, and claim 2 is what carries it.
falsifiable_claims: SUPPORTS ACTUALLY DIFFER: on the gold-absent decisive items, the union of the four framings' supports strictly contains pi_A's support on >=50% of items. Falsified if the framings are cosmetic and all four collapse to the same answer distribution — the single most likely way this design dies.

NOVELTY BANDIT BEATS UNIFORM: at matched B=16, Thompson-on-novelty yields more distinct answers discovered per call than (a) uniform round-robin over the same four framings and (b) 16 iid pi_A draws. Falsified if uniform round-robin matches it, in which case the bandit is unnecessary and the work reduces to DivSampling.

BREADTH SEPARATES: on the decisive stratum, P(br>=2 | x is gold and gold is in pool) - P(br>=2 | x is the wrong plurality) >= 0.30. Falsified if wrong attractors are framing-invariant too — plausible if the shared error lives in the model's parametric knowledge rather than in its derivation path, which would kill the selector while leaving the coverage half alive.
BOUNDED FRAMING TAX: no single non-base framing sits more than 8 pts below pi_A's solo accuracy. Any framing that does is dropped from the ladder before the main study (pre-registered).

NO EASY-ITEM REGRESSION: on the non-decisive stratum, breadth-argmax loses <=1 pt versus count-argmax. Falsified if breadth systematically promotes a rare cross-framing coincidence over a solid plurality.
candidates.cheapest_decisive_test:
Framing-divergence screen, 640 calls, before any bandit is written.
Take the 10 known plurality-wrong items plus 30 sampled plurality-correct items from the frozen corpus. Run 4 samples from each of the 4 framings on all 40 items (640 calls). This one grid answers claims 1, 3, 4 and 5 simultaneously and requires no adaptive machinery: (i) per-framing support sets and their union, with the primary endpoint being how many of the 6 gold-absent items get gold from ANY non-base framing in 12 non-base draws — against the control of 0 hits in 96 historical iid draws, 3/6 is p<0.001 by Fisher's exact; (ii) breadth separation computed directly on the labelled grid; (iii) per-framing solo accuracy, which sizes the AIMO3 tax and prunes the ladder; (iv) breadth-argmax vs count-argmax on the 30 easy items.
Only if claim 1 clears 50% is the bandit worth building — the bandit is pure allocation efficiency on top of a support gap, so if the gap is absent there is nothing to allocate over. Order the two candidates by cost: SPAR's Arm A is 200 calls and its claim 1 is FREE on existing traces, so run SPAR's gates first; FORK's 640-call grid is the fallback if SPAR's repulsion return-rate fails to discriminate, since FORK needs no such behavioural response from the model — only that four framings differ.

verdicts.name: Mode-Exclusion Resampling (MER)
verdicts.kill_reason: Strongest attack located and it does not land: the anti-consensus literature is all aggregation- or training-side, not generation-side. ARBITER (2605.26172) and ACPO (2602.09341, Anti-Consensus Preference Optimization) exploit majority-vote failures post-hoc or via preference training; Mirror-Consistency (2410.10857) feeds observed discrepancies back; Progressive-Hint/RAD condition POSITIVELY; Huang et al. self-correction replaces rather than pools. Aggressive searches for 'assume the previous answer is wrong and resample', answer-exclusion sampling, and 'disagree with the majority' sampling found no published method that negatively conditions new generations on the pool's own modal answer with a monotone union guard and gold-in-pool accounting. Two real wounds: (1) 'Certainty robustness: LLM stability under self-challenging prompts' (arXiv 2603.03330) already measures the behavioral primitive MER relies on (models' response to being told their answer is systematically wrong) and must be cited; (2) the no-harm claim (union gold-in-pool within 2pp of 16-iid) is quantitatively fragile: under independent draws, halving 16 to 8 baseline draws costs 14.0pp of gold-in-pool at per-draw gold probability 0.2 and 5.4pp at 0.3 (computed); the 2pp bound holds only if within-item correlation is as high on correct answers as on wrong ones — pre-register a weaker bound or justify from the frozen traces first. Also note SPAR's L2 arm is the same mechanism, so the portfolio double-counts this bet.
verdicts.surviving_delta: Generation-time negative conditioning on the pool's own modal answer plus its verbatim method sketch, with a retained-Phase-1 monotone union guard, evaluated by gold-in-pool on the pre-registered decisive stratum at matched budget. No located paper does this; the closest works either never generate new samples (ARBITER), train (ACPO), or condition toward the mode (PHP/RAD). The coverage claim (>=2 of 6 zero-gold items) remains a clean, cheap, falsifiable test.

verdicts.name: Trace-Grounded Method Exclusion (TGME)
verdicts.kill_reason: GuidedSampling (arXiv 2510.03777, Oct 2025) publishes the core loop: inference-time decoupling of exploration and generation, where each new solution 'concept' is generated by conditioning on the original question AND all previously generated concepts to force diversity, one solution generated per concept, evaluated on coverage (pass@50 up ~21.6% over repeated sampling, concepts/instance 1.67 -> 3.03). That is TGME's exclusion-list-conditioned wave structure in all but the source of the list. 'Cast a Wider Net' (arXiv 2605.27000) additionally publishes a planner emitting K methods each conditioned on earlier ones to make attempts complementary for pass@K (training-side). TGME's own defense against DIV-SE/StrategyLLM ('menus are what the model says exists, not what it did') does not distinguish it from GuidedSampling's iterative negative conditioning nearly as cleanly, so the headline mechanism is substantially published.
verdicts.surviving_delta: Three testable residuals: (1) exclusion list harvested from METHOD headers of actually executed solution traces (the empirical attractor) rather than an enumeration phase — a directly testable ablation against GuidedSampling-style enumerated concepts; (2) structural-compliance auditing against the 2606.29985 phrasing-vs-approach gap, which GuidedSampling does not verify; (3) decisive-stratum gold-in-pool accounting at matched budget, versus their aggregate pass@k. The concept-level negative result (confirmed compliance + still 0/6 gold => concept-level errors) also remains valuable. But the paper must be repositioned as an ablation-scale delta on GuidedSampling, not a new mechanism.

verdicts.name: Fork-and-Firewall (FAF)
verdicts.kill_reason: Decisive attack attempted and failed: the nearest unciteed prior art is the Variator agent (arXiv 2505.12938, 'Leveraging LLM Inconsistency to Boost Pass@k'), which generates k task variants and solves one candidate per variant for pass@k — but variants are generated blind from the problem, exactly the SCoP-adjacent control FAF pre-registers as ablation claim 6, so it is a mandatory citation and a control arm, not a scoop. Interpretation-enumeration exists for ambiguous user requests (arXiv 2511.10453) but not as a coverage intervention on math with an answer firewall; 'Beyond the Commitment Boundary' (2606.13603) supports the early-commitment premise without intervening; Premise-Augmented Reasoning Chains (2502.02362) extracts premises for error identification, not branching. No located work harvests commitment points from the model's own truncated setup prefixes and blind-solves alternative readings under a mechanical answer firewall with gold-in-pool as endpoint. One quantitative wound: the stated power calculation is off — at 12 discordant pairs and flip ratio 0.833 (p01=0.25/p10=0.05), exact one-sided McNemar power is 0.68, not 80%; ~15-18 discordant pairs are needed, which n=50-70 decisive items at ~30% discordance still supplies (15-21), so the design survives but the number must be corrected.
verdicts.surviving_delta: Targeted upstream perturbation: fork directives extracted from the model's OWN committed prefixes (vs blind variants in Variator/SCoP — separable via the pre-registered claim-6 ablation), a mechanically auditable answer-tight firewall, the degeneracy-moderation reconciliation with AIMO-3's null, and the 6-call Phase-0 fork-reachability probe that prices the single load-bearing assumption before any build. This is the strongest surviving candidate of the six.

verdicts.name: Consensus-Cut Resampling (CCR)
verdicts.kill_reason: 'Two Failures of Self-Consistency in the Multi-Step Reasoning of LLMs' (arXiv 2305.14279, 2023) already publishes CCR's two operational primitives as 'compositional consistency': asking the model an intermediate sub-question in isolation, and substituting model-produced values for intermediate steps back into the main problem to complete the solution — Stage 2 and Stage 3 verbatim, including the finding that these conditionals dissociate from the joint solve. It is framed as an evaluation of inconsistency rather than a coverage intervention, but CCR's core capability bet ('isolated sub-question is easier; downstream-given-pivot is mechanical') is that paper's measurement apparatus, and it is absent from CCR's prior-art positioning. Decomposition-then-solve is further crowded by Least-to-Most, Decomposed Prompting, and Self-Ask. What remains genuinely unlocated is the branch-site rule (cut at maximal cross-sample AGREEMENT — the inverse of ToT/entropy branching) and the union-pool/decisive-stratum framing.
verdicts.surviving_delta: The consensus-cut principle itself: locating the intervention point at the earliest maximally-AGREED derived fact (forced by the project's own stable-wrong-majority finding), the vote-share-proportional value branching that always retains the consensus value, the agreement-vs-disagreement cut ablation (claim 5), and the $5 oracle-repair probe whose (a)x(b) product upper-bounds yield before any pipeline exists and arbitrates FAF-vs-CCR. Must be rewritten as 'compositional consistency (2305.14279), weaponized for coverage at a consensus-located cut', with that paper as the anchor citation.

verdicts.name: SPAR (Saturation-Probed Allocation with Repulsion)
verdicts.kill_reason: Three of four components are published, and one headline statistic is wrong. (1) Trigger: CITE (arXiv 2605.05873) — already on this project's own wall-#5 scoop list — explicitly grounds self-consistency sampling decisions in Good-Turing/Good-Toulmin missing-mass estimation; u_t = n1/t is that machinery, so the trigger's novelty reduces entirely to 'switch instead of stop'. (2) Selection: the R return-rate is 'answer stability under perturbation as a correctness signal', published as SAC3 (arXiv 2311.01740: consistency under semantically-equivalent question perturbation detects question-level hallucination) and measured behaviorally in 'Certainty robustness' (2603.03330, stability under self-challenging prompts); SPAR's variant (method-repulsion rather than question paraphrase) is an increment, not a new channel. (3) The ladder: L2 is MER's mechanism, L3 is brainstorm-then-select (already in the known-prior-art list), L1 is DIV-SE-style directives. (4) Computed numbers: the pre-registered claim '3/6 hits from 24 escalated draws is p<0.001 by Fisher's exact against 0/96' is false — draw-level Fisher gives p=0.0072, and that test is anti-conservative because the 96 historical draws are 16x6 correlated within items; the honest item-level test (3/6 vs 0/6) gives p=0.091. p<0.001 requires >=5 escalated gold draws. The +0.84pt/item and 0.933->0.967 ceiling arithmetic do check out (1/119=0.0084; 0.933+4/119=0.967).
verdicts.surviving_delta: The one unlocated piece: saturation-triggered POLICY SWITCHING at strictly matched budget — every located missing-mass/adaptive-consistency work (CITE, Adaptive-Consistency, ESC, DynScaling, ReASC 2601.02970, CGES 2511.02603) uses saturation to stop and bank compute; none redirects the saved draws to a different generation policy. That redirect, plus using the same escalated calls twice (coverage + R measurement), is a real but narrow delta. Salvage requires: fix the Fisher claim (power the probe for >=5 escalated hits or more items), cite CITE/SAC3/2603.03330 as component prior art, and de-duplicate L2 against MER.

verdicts.name: FORK (Framing-Stratified Allocation by a Novelty Bandit)
verdicts.kill_reason: The coverage half — the load-bearing claim 1 — is already published on the same benchmark family: 'Expanding Search Space with Diverse Prompting Agents' (arXiv 2410.09780) shows on MATH/MATH-hard that distinct prompting methods explore distinct search spaces and that uniformly combining samples across them expands the reachable answer space, achieving maximum search space with ~43% fewer runs than single methods. That is 'the union of framings' supports strictly contains pi_A's support', measured, on MATH-hard — and it is absent from FORK's prior-art positioning, which cites only Paraphrase-and-Solve and DivSampling. The selection half (policy breadth) is cross-prompt-agreement confidence, which the candidate itself concedes is well-trodden. The allocation half sits in a crowded bandit-for-prompt/strategy-selection literature (survey arXiv 2505.13355; per-instance reasoning-mode bandits, e.g. 2506.20357), differing only in the reward definition. FORK also inherits SPAR's statistical error verbatim: '3/6 is p<0.001 by Fisher's exact against 0/96' — the item-level test gives p=0.091 and the draw-level anti-conservative version 0.007.
verdicts.surviving_delta: One narrow, real residual: Thompson sampling on a LABEL-FREE NOVELTY reward (did this call add a new answer to the union pool) for per-item allocation — all located bandit work rewards quality/accuracy and needs a judge or labels; none rewards pool coverage. That delta only matters if claim 2 (novelty bandit beats uniform round-robin at matched budget) holds, since 2410.09780 already owns the uniform-mixing result; the 640-call grid should therefore be re-scoped to make the bandit-vs-uniform comparison, not support-divergence, the primary endpoint, and the breadth selector demoted to a secondary analysis. Fix the Fisher claim as in SPAR.

verdicts.name: Mode-Exclusion Resampling (MER): negative conditioning on the pool's own modal answer
verdicts.kill_reason: Three independent hits, each sufficient. (1) MECHANISM MISMATCH + DOMINANCE: the measured correlation is path-level (same wrong derivation every draw), but MER's distinctive component negates the ANSWER token. On the 6 zero-gold items the evidence (0/96 draws) says conditional gold mass given the attractor path is ~0; masking m1 renormalizes over the residual OBSERVED support — the other wrong answers — because banning an answer does not remove the method that generates it. The one thing MER does at path level (excluding a single verbatim method sketch) is a strict subset of TGME, which does full method exclusion WITHOUT putting an answer token in context. MER = TGME-lite plus a contamination surface. (2) CASH-OUT ARITHMETIC FAILS: its composition claim leans on TACT, but flipping a stable-wrong cluster of 8 with 2 gold votes needs mean-confidence ratio c_g/c_w > 4 (>2.67 even at 3 gold votes); with confidently-wrong majorities at c_w≈0.8 and confidence bounded by 1, the max achievable ratio is ~1.25 — computed, not arguable. Worse, Phase-2 confidence is elicited under an adversarial 'treat m1 as systematic error' preamble — a different protocol — and the project's own finding is that measurements are protocol-dependent, so the D=+0.250 asset does not transfer. (3) NO-HARM IS ON THE WRONG ENDPOINT + PRIOR ART: the monotone guard protects gold-in-POOL, but on the ~109 plurality-correct items 8/16 draws are anti-conditioned against the CORRECT answer (Huang et al. capitulation); simulation with per-draw correct prob p=0.6–0.7, avoid-rate 0.5–0.7, second-attractor share 0.5–0.7 gives P(SC flips wrong) = 0.07–0.34 per marginal item, and no falsifiable claim bounds SC accuracy on that stratum. And the core prompt move — re-solve with prior answers listed as suspected-wrong to avoid repeating them — is published: Progressive Rectification Prompting (arXiv 2312.06867, AAAI 2024) 're-generates the reasoning path hinted with a set of incorrect answers to prevent repeating previous mistakes.' MER's residual delta (apply it label-free to the pool mode, unconditionally) is exactly the part that mis-fires on correct majorities.

verdicts.name: Trace-Grounded Method Exclusion (TGME): sequential sampling that bans the model's own observed strategies, never its answers
verdicts.kill_reason: Two real wounds, neither yet fatal. (1) THE COMPLIANCE GUARD IS CIRCULAR: the failure mode it must exclude (2606.29985: nominal/phrasing diversity with flat approach diversity) is precisely 'surface differs, computation identical' — yet the proposed detector is embedding distance on solution bodies, a SURFACE metric. A trace that re-runs the attractor computation with different wording passes the ≥60% threshold; the guard can certify compliance exactly when compliance failed. The 'independent judge' fallback is the only sound version and must be primary, with a calibration set of known-relabeled traces. (2) VOTE DILUTION IS UNANSWERED: the no-harm claim bounds gold-in-POOL on plurality-correct items, but 12 of 16 draws are method-banned there, so correct-vote mass rides on 4 seeds plus whatever reconverges; nothing bounds SC/TACT ACCURACY on that stratum, and if forced traces cluster on a common second attractor a 4-seed plurality is beatable. Symmetrically on the decisive stratum: waves scatter across methods, so gold plausibly enters with 1–3 votes against a retained wrong cluster — needing c_g/c_w > 2.7–8 to flip when ~1.25 is the achievable maximum. TGME as specified raises the ceiling without any mechanism to cash it; it must either show forced waves CLUSTER on gold or pre-register itself as ceiling-only.
verdicts.surviving_delta: The only candidate whose intervention is aimed at the exact measured object — path-level error correlation — with no answer token ever in context (no ISC/anchoring surface), answer-reconvergence preserved as evidence, an explicit separability test against MER, and the cheapest honest negative in the portfolio: confirmed compliance + 0/6 coverage would establish that decisive errors are concept-level and close the corner. Fix the compliance metric (judge-primary, calibrated) and add an SC-accuracy bound on the plurality-correct stratum, and this is fundable at ~$1.50.

verdicts.name: Fork-and-Firewall (FAF): commitment-point branching with an answer-tight context barrier
verdicts.kill_reason: The decisive attack is vote dilution, and it fails only because FAF never makes the claim it would kill: directives are deduped, so gold enters via ~1 branch vote against 4 seed wrong votes — flipping needs c_g > 4·c_w, impossible with confidence ≤ 1 — hence decisive-stratum SC/TACT ACCURACY cannot move at n=16 even when the ceiling does. FAF's endpoints are honest about this: primary = gold-in-pool (the open corner's stated target), dilution is bounded only on the non-decisive stratum (claim 4), and the targeting ablation (claim 6) is pre-registered as a kill condition against the generic-retry collapse. Secondary attacks also fail to land: ISC echo is handled by a mechanically auditable double firewall (truncation before first derived numeral + numeral-containment filter, claim 2 = 100% audit); the AIMO-3 null is answered with a falsifiable moderation hypothesis (their rho-hat=-0.122 regime had nothing to decorrelate; ours is degenerate); the n=10 power problem is pre-empted by requiring an expanded n≥50 stratum. Remaining wounds to log, not kills: the numeral-based cut/filter is weak on symbolic-answer items and pre-numeric misreads (misreading 'at least' as 'exactly' introduces no numeral); Stage-1 enumeration is performed by the same model whose blind spot caused the error, so it may be unable to name exactly the unseen reading — but that is the single load-bearing bet and Phase 0 isolates it for 6 calls before any pipeline exists, the best kill-test design in the portfolio.
verdicts.surviving_delta: Novel and testable: harvesting COMMITMENT POINTS from the model's own truncated setup prefixes (its empirical attractor, not an a-priori menu a la DIV-SE/Self-Contrast) and solving alternatives in answer-free contexts, evaluated on gold-in-pool over the plurality-wrong stratum at matched budget — an endpoint no named prior work reports. Plus the degeneracy-moderation hypothesis reconciling with AIMO-3, falsifiable in claim 5. Condition of survival: it is a ceiling-raising result only; cashing the ceiling label-free at n=16 is arithmetically impossible and must be stated as out of scope.

verdicts.name: Consensus-Cut Resampling (CCR): branch where the samples agree, not where they disagree
verdicts.kill_reason: Three mechanism wounds. (1) CUT-PLACEMENT MISALIGNMENT: the rule 'earliest fact ≥3/4 seeds agree on' has no mechanism tying it to the error site — the earliest agreed derived fact is typically a trivially correct opening step (correlated errors make seeds agree on wrong facts too, but they agree on the easy correct ones FIRST). When the cut lands on a correct fact, Stage 2 confirms it, V collapses to the consensus value, and Stage 3 burns 8 calls re-solving with an unhelpful given — reproducing the attractor and CONCENTRATING the wrong cluster from 4 votes toward 10–12. On failure CCR is anti-dilutive in the worst way: it makes stable wrong majorities MORE stable. (2) SEMANTIC FRAME INHERITANCE: q_c is authored by the seeds' own <facts> blocks; a model that misread the problem writes a sub-question that encodes the misreading. The firewall checks numerals, not frames, so on setup-level errors the 'isolated' sub-derivation answers the misread question. This bites exactly on the decisive stratum, because the measured signature there (stable, confident, same-path, surviving 16 iid draws) is that of systematic setup/concept errors — a genuine slip at a pivot is high-entropy and would have decorrelated across 16 draws, i.e., those items mostly already have gold in pool. CCR's causal story therefore predicts gains on the items that need it least. (3) PROBE-PIPELINE MISMATCH: the oracle-repair probe hand-places the cut at the true earliest error using gold, so (a)x(b) upper-bounds an ORACLE-cut pipeline, not the consensus-cut rule; a passing probe does not validate cut placement, and Phase 1 could fail expensively after a clean probe. Valid as a kill test, invalid as a confirm.
verdicts.surviving_delta: The capability decomposition itself — 'isolated sub-question is easier' x 'downstream given the pivot is mechanical' — is a claim distinct from diversity injection and genuinely outside the AIMO-3 null, and the $5 oracle-repair probe is the sharpest portfolio-arbitration instrument on the table (its four-way decision rule, including 'both low ⇒ the corner is empty at this model scale,' is the cheapest possible test of whether the whole decorrelation program has anything to find). To proceed past the probe it needs a cut-placement audit (fraction of consensus cuts landing at or upstream of the true first error) inserted before Phase 1, and a bound on the Stage-3 wrong-vote concentration effect.

verdicts.name: SPAR — Saturation-Probed Allocation with Repulsion (sequential redirect, not stop)
verdicts.kill_reason: Four wounds of decreasing severity. (1) R's DISCRIMINATION ASSUMPTION IS ALREADY CONTRADICTED FOR A KNOWN ERROR SUBCLASS: the claim 'a wrong attractor born of one flawed path is not re-reachable once that path is blocked' fails whenever the error lives upstream of the method — a misread or wrong parametric fact returns the SAME wrong answer under ANY method, because every method operates on the misread problem. The project's own FIB result (frame-invariant errors survive perturbation) is direct evidence this subclass is populated, and the decisive stratum's stable-confident signature suggests heavily. Symmetrically, R(a1|correct) ≥ 0.5 requires Haiku to re-derive L5 answers by genuinely different methods half the time — capability-optimistic for a small model at the difficulty frontier. Both failure modes are named and pre-registered, but the prior weight on them is high. (2) STATISTICAL OVERSTATEMENT IN THE CHEAP TEST: 'p<0.001 by Fisher vs 0/96' treats 96 draws as independent when the entire premise of the project is that they are CORRELATED (ICC near 1); the honest item-level control is 0/6, and Fisher on [[3,3],[0,6]] gives p≈0.09 — the headline significance is inflated by ~3 orders of magnitude and the 24-draw screen is not 'decisive.' (3) TRIGGER DEGENERACY: u_t < 0.10 for all t ≤ 10 is literally n1 = 0 — 'no singleton answers yet.' The Good–Turing dressing is real but at these sample sizes the trigger reduces to near-unanimity detection, firing earliest on unanimous (mostly easy-correct) items; the margin/missing-mass dissociation argument is correct in principle but nearly vacuous at t=8. (4) L3 CEILING INFLATION: counting an enumerated, underived answer among 5 armchair guesses as 'gold-in-pool' breaks comparability with the baseline ceiling accounting (which counts solved traces) and produces maximally uncashable coverage.
verdicts.surviving_delta: SPAR is the ONLY candidate with a non-vacuous answer to the two-world/vote-dilution attack: the R override cashes a 2-vote gold without needing vote mass or an impossible confidence ratio, and R is measured behavior under a NEW policy — a new information channel formally outside the fixed-pool impossibility results, and genuinely distinct from verifier judgment (no model is asked 'is this right'). Claim 1 costs zero new calls on the frozen corpus and Arm A has pre-registered kill thresholds. Surviving core: fixed-point-under-method-perturbation as a label-free correctness correlate — provided the cheap test is re-powered honestly (item-level exact test, more items) and gold-in-pool accounting excludes bare L3 nominations.

verdicts.name: FORK — Framing-Stratified Allocation by a Novelty Bandit
verdicts.kill_reason: Both novel halves fail on mechanism, and the remainder is measured-losing prior art. (1) THE SELECTOR IS CONTRADICTED BY THE PROJECT'S OWN DATA: breadth-argmax rests on 'a wrong attractor is a property of one framing' — but the project's FIB result established that the decisive errors are FRAME-INVARIANT (they survive input perturbation precisely because they live in the model's parametric commitments, not the prompt). So br(wrong attractor) will be high across the four framings exactly on the decisive stratum, collapsing the ≥0.30 separation of claim 3; the candidate itself names this failure mode as 'plausible' without registering that the in-house evidence already points to it. (2) THE BANDIT — the admitted sole defensible novelty — IS BOTH UNDERPOWERED AND PERVERSELY REWARDED. Underpowered: B=16 minus round-1 (4) minus 2-per-arm floors leaves ~4–8 free draws to learn 4 Beta posteriors from 1–2 observations each; simulation with Beta(1,3) shrinkage puts only 42.5% of free draws on a true-0.50-novelty arm vs 0.15 competitors (uniform = 25%) — an expected advantage of ~1.4 draws per item, indistinguishable from round-robin, so claim 2 fails and FORK reduces by its own admission to DivSampling. Perverse: the reward r=1 for ANY unseen answer is maximized by the least reliable framing — a junk arm scattering wrong answers has novelty ~0.95 and captures 68% of the free budget in simulation, starving the framings that produce repeated (i.e., meaningful) answers. Novelty is not coverage-of-gold; the objective actively finances noise, which then feeds the selector as spurious breadth-1 singletons. (3) WHAT REMAINS is uniform multi-framing pooled by vote — DIV-SE / Diverse-Prompt-Mixer territory, which AIMO-3 measured below baseline on every arm — plus the same inflated '3/6 vs 0/96, p<0.001' screen statistics as SPAR (honest item-level p≈0.09). The 640-call grid would measure something (claim 1's support-union question), but that is a screen of known techniques, not a defensible contribution.

verdicts.name: Mode-Exclusion Resampling (MER): negative conditioning on the pool's own modal answer
verdicts.kill_reason: No operating point with positive net exists. REVENUE: on a successfully converted decisive item, gold enters with E~1.6 copies (8 conditioned draws x conditional mass ~0.2) against ~10.4 attractor votes (8x0.9 retained Phase-1 + Phase-2 basin-return ~0.4x8, using MER's own decorrelation target <0.5). Flipping needs a weight ratio of 6.5; the measured confidence asset (D=+0.250, e.g. 0.85 vs 0.60) supplies 1.42 (linear weights) to 3.78 (log-odds weights) — CISC-style weighted voting (arXiv 2502.06233) is exactly this channel and is documented as a sample-efficiency device, not an entrenched-majority flipper. So SC cash = 0 and TACT cash ~ 0 under ANY weighting functional: the claimed +2.25 pts of ceiling (2/6 conversions on the 89-item accounting, 1.12 pts/item) is stranded ceiling. COST: MER's only no-harm claim is on gold-in-pool, not accuracy — there is no accuracy endpoint protecting the 79 plurality-correct items from 8 traces instructed to treat the correct answer as a systematic error. Monte Carlo with Phase-2 correct-rate q and correlated capitulation concentration c (correlated errors are the project's own finding, so capitulation mass concentrates): q=0.5,c=0.5 loses 0.6 items (0.66 pts); q=0.3,c=0.5 loses 2.8 items (3.14 pts); q=0.3,c=0.7 loses 6.1 items (6.9 pts). Break-even therefore requires q>=0.7 AND a weight ratio >=6.5 simultaneously; down-weighting Phase-2 'for accuracy' to dodge the loss zeroes the gain by the same stroke. Cost > cashable revenue at every plausible parameter setting. Kill-test power is also oversold: at the claimed conversion rate, P(pass >=2/6)=0.47 — a coin flip; only 0/6 is a reliable read.
verdicts.surviving_delta: Nothing method-level survives at matched budget. The $1 / 80-generation coverage probe retains diagnostic value (answer-anchoring vs capability-limited), but TGME's probe buys a strictly sharper version of the same diagnosis at the same price, so MER is not even the efficient way to ask its own question.

verdicts.name: Trace-Grounded Method Exclusion (TGME): sequential sampling that bans the model's own observed strategies, never its answers
verdicts.kill_reason: Same cashing wall, worse dilution, and its claims are structured so the method can pass all five while delivering zero points. REVENUE: converted-item vote arithmetic gives gold ~1.5 copies vs ~7.2 attractor votes (4x0.9 seeds + ~30% forced-wave reconvergence, which the design explicitly preserves as 'evidence FOR'); needed weight ratio 4.8 exceeds even log-odds TACT at measured D (3.78), so realized SC/TACT gain ~0 even if the coverage claim fully succeeds. Critically, the falsifiable-claims list contains NO union-pool accuracy endpoint (claim 4 is gold-in-pool only) — the endpoint that would expose this is simply absent. COST: 12/16 draws are forced onto non-preferred methods on 100% of items — the AIMO3 uniform-diversity tax paid on the ~89% of items with zero headroom, anchored by only a 4-seed iid tally; plus an unpriced 4x latency from sequential waves. Net at matched budget: <= 0.
verdicts.surviving_delta: The instrument, not the method. Its cheapest-decisive-test is the best purchase in the whole portfolio: ~$1.50 / 120 generations, and the negative outcome (compliance >=60% AND 0/6 gold) is the concept-level-vs-path-level discriminator that would close the entire decorrelation corner — a publishable negative bought for lunch money. Caveat to pre-register: at true conversion 25% the >=2/6 pass gate is a 47% coin flip; only the 0/6 hard-kill arm is statistically reliable at n=6.

verdicts.name: Fork-and-Firewall (FAF): commitment-point branching with an answer-tight context barrier
verdicts.kill_reason: Best experimental economics in the portfolio, but the revenue mechanics are broken by its own allocation rule: 1 branch per directive means gold enters the pool with exactly 1 vote against ~3.6 expected seed-attractor votes (4 seeds x 0.9). Flat SC-16 mathematically cannot cash a 1-vote answer, and TACT needs weight ratio 3.6 vs the measured 1.42 (linear) / 3.78 (log-odds boundary). Consequence: the PRIMARY endpoint (gold-in-pool 0.40 -> 0.60 on n>=50 decisive items) can be fully met while realized accuracy moves ~0 — the pre-registered experiment can 'succeed' without producing a bankable point. Break-even in points: gain ~0 to +1.1 pts (occasional log-odds TACT flips), cost bounded at 1.5 pts by claim 4 — the net straddles zero, and the $100 Phase-1 spend buys a coverage number the design cannot convert. The fix (a reallocation wave that promotes directives whose branch produced a novel answer to multiple votes, CCR-style) has no room at B=16 without cutting directives, i.e., trading the coverage the primary claim is about.
verdicts.surviving_delta: The Phase-0 fork-reachability probe is the single best $1 in the portfolio: 6 calls that isolate the load-bearing enumeration-beats-selection asymmetry before any code exists — that asymmetry is genuinely untested in the named prior art. The degeneracy-moderation hypothesis reconciling AIMO-3's null (gain monotone in top-1 share, <=0 below 0.4) is a real, falsifiable, regime-defining claim worth testing regardless of FAF's fate. FAF becomes fundable iff Phase-0 passes AND a vote-reallocation stage is added so coverage has a cashing path.

verdicts.name: Consensus-Cut Resampling (CCR): branch where the samples agree, not where they disagree
verdicts.kill_reason: Attacks that fail: the cashing wall does not kill it — CCR is the only pool-voting candidate whose vote arithmetic lands inside the measured confidence channel. Proportional downstream allocation multiplies gold's count: Stage-2 vote 3/4 for the gold pivot gives gold 6 downstream calls x 0.6 = 3.6 votes vs 5.2 attractor votes — required weight ratio 1.44, at linear-TACT's measured 1.42 and comfortably inside log-odds 3.78 (worst case 2/4 split needs 2.83, still inside log-odds). Cost side is the smallest of all six: on the 79 settled items the consensus pivot is correct, downstream re-solves reproduce the correct answer, dilution ~0, and 4 of 16 calls are short. The $5 oracle-repair probe computes a hard per-item yield UPPER BOUND (a)x(b) before any pipeline exists and arbitrates the whole portfolio — the best decision-theoretic spend proposed. Net realized estimate at matched budget: +1 to +2.5 pts against ~-0.5 pts risk, the only positive-expectation ledger in the set.
verdicts.surviving_delta: Precisely: pivot-isolation plus vote-share-proportional reallocation as the only generation-time intervention whose coverage converts to realized accuracy at B=16. Two conditions to pre-register or it degrades to FAF's fate: (1) realized gain is 100% TACT-dependent (SC-flat still loses 3.6 vs 5.2 even in the best case), so the weight functional (linear vs log-odds) must be fixed IN ADVANCE — CISC (arXiv 2502.06233) shows this channel's flip-power is functional-form-sensitive and normally used for sample-efficiency, not majority-flipping; (2) regime honesty: total addressable realized headroom is +2-3.4 pts on Haiku/MATH-L5 where the decisive stratum is 11%; SC-16 Haiku already costs ~5 Sonnet-class single calls, so the result is a science claim about correlated-error repair, valid only in the cheap-model/hard-benchmark/rho->1 regime, not a deployment method.

verdicts.name: SPAR — Saturation-Probed Allocation with Repulsion (sequential redirect, not stop)
