verdicts.kill_reason: The cost structure is the best conceived (redirects draws with provably ~0 marginal coverage value; conservative keep-a1 default; free claim-1 gate on frozen traces), and its override is the only selection rule that needs no out-vote — but the override's statistics are fatally underpowered at the design's own operating point, and its claims 3 and 4 are mutually inconsistent. With n_L2=4 (its own cheap-test spec), the threshold R_hat<=0.25 means '<=1 of 4 return'; at the pre-registered PASS floor R(a1|correct)=0.50, P(R_hat<=0.25)=0.3125 per escalated correct item. Jointly with b>=2 under correlated capitulation (correlated errors are the project's own finding), Monte Carlo gives false-override rates of 15-25% -> 8-14 flips among ~55 escalated plurality-correct items = -9 to -15 pts, against gain ~+2.4 items (+2.7 pts). Claim 4 (<=1 flip) is violated at every R_corr < ~0.8: net is -10.2 pts at R_corr=0.5, -4.1 at 0.6, -0.2 at 0.7, and only +1.9 pts at R_corr=0.8. So the method is viable only under a behavioral premise (R_corr>=~0.8) far stronger than the one it pre-registers (0.5), or with n_L2>=8-12 — which the B_rem~8 escalation budget cannot supply while also buying coverage: the celebrated double-use of calls (coverage AND R-measurement) is exactly what breaks. Prior-art check: the Good-Turing-triggered policy SWITCH is not scooped (nearest: arXiv 2604.19162 uses missing mass for hallucination alphabets; 2604.01413 for conformal stopping) — the wound is statistical, not novelty.
verdicts.surviving_delta: Three components survive intact: (1) the free u_t gate — claim 1 costs $0 on frozen traces and should be run today regardless; (2) the redirect-not-stop framing against Adaptive-Consistency/ESC, which is genuinely new and economically sound (diverted draws had ~0 marginal value on saturated-correct items); (3) the no-out-vote override concept. Re-specify with R-floor 0.75-0.8 as the pass criterion or n_L2>=8 (accepting halved coverage buy), and the $5 Arm A prices the corrected premise before further spend. As designed, it fails its own <=1-flip constraint at its own claimed pass threshold.

verdicts.name: FORK — Framing-Stratified Allocation by a Novelty Bandit
verdicts.kill_reason: The self-identified novel component cannot express itself at B=16, and the rest of the budget is spent where upside is zero. (1) Bandit is decorative: with the 2-per-arm floor, only 8 of 16 draws are allocatable and Thompson posteriors rest on 1-2 observations/arm. Simulation under bandit-FAVORABLE assumptions (stationary novelty, no depletion) gives Thompson advantage over round-robin of +0.146 distinct answers per decisive item — 16% of the oracle-allocation bound (+0.9) — and -0.001 on settled items, i.e. corpus-weighted +0.0155 answers/item ~ +0.035 pts. Detecting claim 2 at that effect size needs ~1,700 decisive items ~ 20,000+ raw items at the 8.4% base rate: the load-bearing claim is untestable at any budget the project contemplates, and the proposal itself concedes the selector half (prompt-agreement/breadth) is well-trodden. (2) Guardrail burns the budget: 79 settled items x 12 'break the agreement' calls = 948 of 1,424 corpus calls (67%) allocated where the decision can only change via a breadth-selector misfire — pure downside purchase. (3) Claim 4 tolerates framings 8 pts below base accuracy in a pool that VOTES, with no bounded-downside default analogous to SPAR's keep-a1 override. (4) Dominated by SPAR on every economic margin: gate cost (640 calls vs $0), minimum uniform diversion (8/16 on every item vs conditional escalation), selection downside (unbounded breadth-argmax vs override-bounded). The one testable asset (framings have disjoint supports, claim 1) is purchasable inside SPAR's Arm B or TGME's $1.50 probe without building any bandit.
verdicts.surviving_delta: None as designed. The four-framing ladder itself is worth salvaging as additional entries in SPAR's L1 directive bank (costs nothing, preserves the support-union hypothesis), and policy-label retention for breadth as a FREE diagnostic column — but breadth as the argmax selector and Thompson allocation at horizon 8 are both economically dead.

pick:
## PICK: **Fork-and-Firewall, revised — FAF-R** (Fork-and-Firewall with novelty reallocation)

Everything else is dead or dominated. MER: killed 2-of-3 lenses on vote arithmetic (needs weight ratio 6.5, max achievable ~1.25–3.78) and on unbounded flips of the plurality-correct stratum; also substantially published (PRP, arXiv 2312.06867). FORK: killed 2-of-3; the bandit cannot express itself at horizon 8 (+0.035 pts, needs ~20k items to detect) and the breadth selector is contradicted by our own FIB result. TGME: headline loop published as GuidedSampling (2510.03777); residual is an ablation. SPAR: fails its own ≤1-flip constraint at its own pass threshold (−10.2 pts at R_corr=0.5); statistically underpowered override. CCR: best cash-out arithmetic in the portfolio, but its two operational primitives are published verbatim (compositional consistency, 2305.14279), its cut rule has no mechanism tying it to the error site, and — decisively — its own $5 probe validates an *oracle*-cut pipeline, so it can pass its gate and fail Phase 1. **CCR's proportional-reallocation idea is the one thing worth stealing, and FAF-R steals it.**

---

### Revised claim (all surviving attacks folded in)

> On a frozen small model in the **degenerate-pool regime**, extracting *commitment points* from the model's own truncated setup prefixes and blind-solving the alternative readings in answer-free contexts raises **gold-in-pool on the plurality-wrong stratum at matched generation budget**, above both iid SC-16 and any scalar decoding knob (temperature / min-p), and above blind (problem-only) variant generation. Novelty-proportional reallocation converts *part* of that coverage into realized accuracy under TACT weighting; the method is pre-registered as **coverage-primary, accuracy-no-harm**, because at B=16 a one-vote answer is arithmetically uncashable and we will not pretend otherwise.

Three concessions relative to the original FAF, each forced by an attack:

1. **Ceiling-first, honestly.** Lens 3 is right: 1 branch per directive → gold enters with 1 vote against ~3.6–5.4 seed votes; flat SC-16 cannot flip it at any weighting. So the primary endpoint stays gold-in-pool, and accuracy is a *constraint plus a secondary upside test*, never the headline.
2. **Budget re-split + reallocation wave** (the CCR steal): 6 seeds / 6 wave-A branches / 4 wave-B reallocation, 16 solution-length calls. Wave B is allocated only to directives whose wave-A answer is **novel** (absent from the seed answer set), proportional, capped at +3 to any single answer. Bounded-downside default: **if no novel answer appears, wave B reverts to 4 additional iid seeds**, so the method degrades toward SC-10 rather than toward noise. Converted item: gold cluster ≤4 vs seed attractor ~5.4 → required TACT ratio ≈1.35, inside the measured linear-weight ratio 1.42. Marginal by construction; stated as such.
3. **Firewall widened.** The numeral-containment filter is blind to pre-numeric misreads ("at least" → "exactly") and to symbolic-answer items. Cut rule becomes: first derived numeral **or** first quantifier/condition commitment token, whichever is earlier; symbolic-answer items are reported as a separate stratum where the mechanical guarantee is weaker and a judge audit substitutes.

Also folded: Variator (2505.12938) becomes a **mandatory citation and the blind-fork control arm**, not a footnote; the McNemar power number is corrected (12 discordant pairs → 0.68 power; need 15–18).

---

### Regime (explicit)

Target: **single frozen cheap model, items at its capability frontier, pooled top-1 share ≥ 0.4, measured pairwise error correlation ρ > 0, SC-16 already saturated.** This is the regime our decisive-stratum data lives in and the regime AIMO-3's null does *not* cover (they measured ρ̂ = −0.122 — already decorrelated, nothing to fix).

**Not** targeted, and pre-registered as expected-null: saturated benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH L1–3), frontier models on the same items, and any setting where the honest move is to buy a bigger model — SC-16 on Haiku already costs ~5 Sonnet-class calls. This is a science claim about repairing correlated errors, not a deployment recommendation.

---

### Pre-registered falsifiers

**F0 — free gate, zero new calls.** Subsample 6 of the 16 frozen baseline traces (×20 subsamples). If **SC-6 loses more than 1.5 pts to SC-16**, the 6/10 budget split is infeasible and FAF-R is dead before a single new generation. Run this today.

**F1 — Phase-0 fork reachability (the load-bearing bet), ~15 calls, <$2.** On zero-gold decisive items, run Stage-1 extraction only and hand-check offline against gold whether *any* admitted directive corresponds to the gold setup. **<30% ⇒ enumeration-beats-selection is false; STOP.** This prices the entire thesis before any pipeline exists.

**F2 — PRIMARY: gold-in-pool on the decisive stratum at matched budget vs iid SC-16.** Pre-registered on decisive ∩ *capability-reachable* items, n ≥ 50. Target: baseline 0.40 → ≥0.60. Exact McNemar on discordant pairs, ≥15 pairs required (corrected). Item-level exact tests only — the 96 historical draws are within-item correlated and any draw-level Fisher claim is inflated by ~3 orders of magnitude.

**F3 — VOTE DILUTION / no accuracy drop.** End-to-end accuracy of the declared selector (TACT over the labelled mixed pool) must not fall below iid SC-16 on the **full** substrate: ≤0.5 pts, and ≤1.0 pts on the plurality-correct stratum. Reported alongside — as a diagnostic, not the bar — flat SC over the mixed pool, with the honest prediction that it *will* lose, because 10/16 branch calls means its effective seed plurality is SC-6. If a reviewer insists flat-SC-no-drop is the bar, then no branching method survives at B=16 and that is itself the pre-registered finding.

**F4 — TACT composition, with a protocol-transfer pre-check.** Branch traces are elicited under a different prompt, and this project's own finding is that measurements are protocol-dependent. Before TACT is used at all, re-measure within-item discrimination on branch traces: **if D_branch < +0.15 or flips sign, TACT composition is void** and the result is ceiling-only. If it passes: TACT must recover strictly more of the new ceiling than flat SC. Weight functional (linear vs log-odds) fixed **in advance** — CISC (2502.06233) shows flip-power is functional-form-sensitive.

**F5 — TRIVIAL BASELINE.** FAF-R must beat the best of {T=1.0, T=1.3, min-p=0.05, min-p=0.1, typical-p} at matched B=16 on F2's endpoint. **If a scalar decoding knob matches the coverage gain, FAF-R is dead** — the whole premise is that token-level entropy cannot move distribution-level path correlation.

**F6 — Targeting ablation (kill, not nice-to-have).** FAF-R must beat the blind-fork control (Variator/SCoP-style: same branch count, directives generated *without* seeing any seed prefix). **If not beaten, "use the model against itself" is false even if accuracy improves — report as a kill.**

**F7 — Leakage audit.** 100% mechanical audit: zero admitted directives contain the seed's final answer or any numeral absent from the problem statement. Any leak voids the run.

**F8 — Degeneracy moderation (the AIMO-3 reconciliation).** Gain must be monotone increasing in baseline top-1 share and ≤0 below 0.4. Flat in degeneracy ⇒ the regime story is false.

---

### Minimal experiment (AIME/AMC substrate)

**Substrate.** AMC12 2022–2024 (~150) + AIME I/II 2022–2025 (~120) = **270 items**. Rationale for the substrate change: on AIME/AMC with a cheap model the plurality-wrong stratum is 50–70% rather than MATH-L5's 8.4%, so a 50–100 item decisive stratum comes free instead of requiring 800–950 items.

**Step 1 — stratification (~$60).** SC-16 at T=1.0 → decisive stratum. Then a separate 16-draw high-diversity **reference pool** used *offline only* to label each item **capability-reachable** (gold appears ≥1×) vs **capability-bound**. Labels never enter the method. This is the guard against the AIME failure mode where everything is null for uninteresting reasons — and the unreachable fraction is itself the regime boundary, i.e. the cheapest possible test of whether the open corner is empty at this model scale.

**Step 2 — F0 and F1.** Free, then <$2. Two hard stops before any build.

**Step 3 — main run (~$150 total).** FAF-R-16 on all 270; blind-fork control (F6) and the temperature/min-p arms (F5) on the decisive stratum only. ~14–17k generations.

**Decision rule.** F0 or F1 fails ⇒ stop, report the negative (decisive errors on this substrate are capability-bound, not commitment-bound — which closes the decorrelation corner and is a legitimate sixth death). F2 passes and F3 holds ⇒ a coverage result with an honest ceiling-only caveat. F2 + F4 + F5 + F6 all pass ⇒ the first generation-time intervention in this project that both raises the ceiling and cashes part of it.
